one_improvement: Add a content-based .so partition contract before expensive ELF scanning: exact ZIP .so member set must be exhaustively and disjointly classified as supported ARM64 ELF, ARM32 ELF, or named non-ELF; unknown ABI/missing/duplicate/mislabeled entries fail before scan. Hand each ABI subset to the correct scanner.
pilot_result: Real 456-member TikTok partition PASS (227 ARM64, 225 ARM32, 4 non-ELF); three negative mutations reject wrong-arm64, fake-ELF, and omitted member.
promotion_gate: Candidate only. Another agent must review this pilot and apply as a separate small scanner-preflight change; require the same actual TikTok partition, all negative fixtures, then a second distinct mixed-ABI APK and unchanged source/phase guards before promoting to default across portfolio.
limits: The pilot checks ZIP names and first 64 bytes, not ELF semantic readelf success or nested archives; v2 scanner remains the runtime source for full static results. No production runner or ledger changed.
